build_ibert_masked_lm: build an I-BERT masked language model using IBertForMaskedLM for token prediction with quantized weights
build_ibert_sequence_classifier: build an I-BERT sequence classifier using IBertForSequenceClassification for GLUE task classification
build_ibert_question_answerer: build an I-BERT question answering model using IBertForQuestionAnswering for start and end token prediction
build_ibert_token_classifier: build an I-BERT token classifier using IBertForTokenClassification for named entity recognition tasks
run_ibert_encoder: run the I-BERT encoder using IBertModel with quantized embeddings and integer-only attention layers
